summary: PTL Limited, a Hong Kong-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing the resignation of independent auditor FundCertify CPA Professional Corporation effective September 16, 2026, and the board and audit committee's ratification of Privatco CPA Limited as successor auditor the same day. FundCertify's fiscal 2025 reports were unqualified, with no disagreements, though a previously disclosed material weakness in internal control over financial reporting (personnel, internal audit, IT controls) was noted. No transaction terms apply. What to watch: remediation progress and whether the auditor change signals control or reporting stress.
